questions.question: When approaching a bump or pothole, you should rise slightly off your seat:

options.text: So you can jump off the motorcycle if needed.
So your legs can absorb the shock.
So other drivers can see you better.
So you can see the bump or pothole better.

questions.correctAnswerText: So your legs can absorb the shock.
questions.explanation: When riding over bumps or potholes, rising off your seat lets your joints absorb some of the impact. This keeps the bump from throwing you off the motorcycle.

questions.question: When should you do a pre-ride inspection?
questions.explanation: Check your motorcycle before every ride. It only takes a few minutes and helps prevent problems before you ride in traffic.

questions.question: Which fabric gives the best protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants offer the most protection for motorcycle riders.

questions.question: If you drink alcohol, what should you do?

options.text: Decide if you can ride based on how you feel.
Set a drinking limit so you can still ride safely.
Do not worry about riding if you feel fine.

questions.explanation: The safest choice is to not ride after drinking. Any amount of alcohol can affect your ability to ride safely.

questions.question: What happens if you take a turn too fast?

options.text: It is safe as long as you stay under the speed limit.
It is safer on a motorcycle than in a car.
It is safe as long as no other vehicles are nearby.
You could end up in another lane or off the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could end up in another lane or off the road.
questions.explanation: Taking a turn too fast is dangerous. If you cannot hold the turn, you may slide into another lane or off the road. Always slow down for turns.

questions.question: What is usually in the center of the lane?
questions.explanation: Cars drop oil in the center of the lane. This creates an oily strip. When the road is dry, it is usually still safe for a motorcycle to ride on this center strip.

questions.question: Can clothing help prevent injuries in a crash?

options.text: No, clothing does not protect you.
No, clothing is just a personal choice.
Yes, but only if the clothes are loose and flap in the wind.
Yes, if your jacket and pants cover your arms and legs completely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes, if your jacket and pants cover your arms and legs completely.
questions.explanation: Good clothing reduces injury risk in a crash. Wear a jacket and pants made of sturdy material that cover your arms and legs. They should fit snug so they do not flap in the wind.

questions.question: If someone is tailgating you, what should you do?

options.text: Ride faster to shake them off.

questions.explanation: The best way to handle a tailgater is to let them go ahead. If safe, change lanes and let them pass. Riding faster only increases danger because they may continue tailgating at the higher speed.

questions.question: How often should you completely check your motorcycle?
questions.explanation: A motorcycle needs more frequent checks than a car. Do a complete inspection of your motorcycle before every ride.

questions.question: What happens when alcohol and drugs are used together?

options.text: The effects are stronger than using either one alone.
The effects are less dangerous than using either one alone.
The effects balance each other out.

questions.correctAnswerText: The effects are stronger than using either one alone.
questions.explanation: Many drugs, including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, can make you unable to ride safely. Some drugs become even more dangerous when mixed with alcohol.

questions.question: A rectangular sign may be a:
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs are rectangular. They are white with black letters or symbols. These signs tell you the rules of the road. You must follow them.

questions.question: Which of the following does not protect a motorcycle rider?

options.text: Boots that go over the ankle
A baseball cap that fits snugly

questions.correctAnswerText: A baseball cap that fits snugly
questions.explanation: To stay safe, wear a DOT-approved helmet, face or eye protection, a sturdy jacket and long pants, high boots or shoes that support your ankles, and durable gloves.

questions.question: If you wait one hour to ride after having one alcoholic drink:

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drinking and driving.
Your riding skills will not be affected by the alcohol.
Effects from the alcohol may still remain.
You will be fine as long as you ride slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Effects from the alcohol may still remain.
questions.explanation: Your body removes about one drink's worth of alcohol per hour. But alcohol can still build up in your system. Even after one hour, alcohol can affect your ability to ride safely.

questions.question: When adjusting your rearview mirror, make sure you can:

options.text: See the lane behind you and the lane next to you.
See only the lane behind you.
See only the lane next to you.

questions.correctAnswerText: See the lane behind you and the lane next to you.
questions.explanation: Adjust your mirrors to see the lane behind you and as much as possible of the lane next to you. A mirror may show part of your arm or shoulder, but the road behind and beside you is most important.

questions.question: Which type of sign is yellow with black letters or symbols?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They warn you about upcoming road conditions.

questions.question: Which type of clothing helps other drivers see you?
questions.explanation: Wear gear that makes you and your motorcycle easy to spot. Bright, reflective clothing makes it easier for other drivers to see you.

questions.question: If a friend has been drinking and wants to ride their motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Encourage them to take less-crowded roads.
Encourage friends to talk them out of riding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Encourage friends to talk them out of riding.
questions.explanation: Never let someone who has been drinking ride a motorcycle. Stop them from riding. Get other friends to help you convince them not to ride.

questions.question: When buying a protective jacket or pants, look for items made of:
questions.explanation: Wear long pants and a jacket to cover your arms and legs. Leather clothing offers the best protection.

questions.question: Switching to a lower gear is also called:
questions.explanation: Shifting to a lower gear acts like using the brakes. This is why downshifting is called engine braking.

questions.question: A leather jacket:

options.text: Can make a rider look cool.
Is usually too warm to wear when riding.
Should not be worn when riding.

questions.explanation: Wear a long-sleeved jacket, ideally made of leather, when riding. In hot weather, a leather jacket can help prevent dehydration. Many motorcycle jackets are designed to keep you cool.

questions.question: How can you increase your visibility on a motorcycle?

options.text: Add extra lights to your motorcycle.
Do not use your turn signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Add extra lights to your motorcycle.
questions.explanation: To be more visible, wear bright colors or clothes with reflective materials. You can also add extra lights to your motorcycle, use your turn signals, and flash your brake lights when needed. These help other drivers see you.

questions.question: What should you do when riding on a slippery surface?
questions.explanation: On slippery surfaces, slow down. Use both brakes when you need to stop. Avoid sudden or jerky movements.

questions.question: What must you do if your motorcycle has no windshield?

options.text: You must wear goggles, glasses, or a face shield.
You can only ride between dusk and sunset.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must wear goggles, glasses, or a face shield.
questions.explanation: In Vermont, if your motorcycle does not have a windshield, you must wear goggles, glasses, or a protective face shield while riding.

questions.question: What type of shoes should you wear when riding?

options.text: Shoes with long laces that hang loose.

questions.explanation: Wear boots or shoes that are high and sturdy enough to cover and protect your ankles. Keep heels short so they do not catch on anything. Tuck in laces so they cannot get caught in the motorcycle's moving parts.

questions.question: Where should you ride when following a car?

options.text: In any part of the lane.
In the part closest to the shoulder.
In the position where the car driver can see you in their rearview mirror.
As close to the car as possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the position where the car driver can see you in their rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Ride in a position where the car driver can see you in their rearview mirror. This is usually the center of the lane. Drivers check their rearview mirrors more often than their side mirrors, so this position makes it more likely they will see you.
